title: Bounded decoding value
statement: Let $q$ be a positive integer and let $G$ be a regular unique game over $q$ symbols. Let the table assign to each vertex a function from the Boolean cube $\\{−1,1\\}^{q}$ to $[-1,1]$. For a real parameter $\\varepsilon$ and a default symbol in $\\{0,\\ldots,q-1\\}$, the bounded decoding value is the candidate decoding value formed from the table’s bounded decoding candidates and that default symbol.
hypotheses_covered: A regular unique game with alphabet size $q$
A table of functions on the $q$-dimensional Boolean cube taking values in $[-1,1]$
A default symbol in the alphabet
